title: The Exact Packing Density and Unique Maximizing Permuton of 1324
description: Working paper giving a rigorous Bellman characterization and certified bounds for the packing density of 1324, and proving that every maximizing permuton is layered. Together the results give an exact recursive description of the unique unrestricted maximizing permuton, convergence of near-optimal sequences, and a certified 100-decimal truncation of the density. Prior numerical estimates and symmetrization methods are credited; the problem is packing, not avoidance. AI-assisted and internally reviewed; not externally peer reviewed.
